title: MediaAvatarIngestResult
description: media.avatar-ingest-result@1: the answer of POST /internal/avatar-ingest on OpenVibe.Media: { ok: true, slug, url, width, height, bytes } — the unlisted paste holding the re-encoded avatar and its public https://openvibe.media/p/<slug>/screenshot address (always a 512×512 WebP). Refusals are { ok: false, error } (400, 422).
